header_sub: Enter your Discord user token to connect.
notif_all_desc: Show a balloon for every new message in non-muted channels/servers.
notif_mention_desc:
In servers: only notify when you are directly mentioned.
DMs are always shown regardless of this setting.
chk_auto_open_desc: Launches / brings Discord to focus automatically after signing in.
style_instant_desc:
Every message fires its own balloon immediately.
Best if you're in few/quiet servers.
style_replace_desc:
New messages replace the active balloon after a cooldown.
Prevents spam without losing any notification.
style_queue_desc:
Messages accumulate silently. The balloon shows a count.
Click it to open up Discord.
chk_balloon_sound_desc:
When enabled, your message sound plays once per balloon instead of once per message.
The message sound will NOT be affected by the Volume slider.
sounds_hint: Set a .wav file for each event. Leave blank for silence.
per_user_hint:
Play a custom sound when a specific user triggers an event.
Use the user's Discord ID (18-digit number — enable Developer Mode in Discord).
Message sound is ignored in Queue mode.
icons_hint:
Choose a PNG or ICO icon for each tray state (16×16 or 32×32 recommended).
Leave blank to keep the default Discord icon for that state.
chk_check_updates_desc: Check GitHub for a new version when Balloncord starts.
chk_auto_update_desc: Automatically download and install new versions on startup (requires Check for updates).
balloon_update_body: A new version ({ver}) is available. Click to download now.
balloon_updated_body: v{ver} downloaded. Restart Balloncord to apply.
exit_remember_msg: Remember this choice and don't ask again?
notif_type_balloon_desc: Use the standard Windows tray balloon notifications.
notif_type_popup_desc: Show retro-style popup windows that slide up from behind the taskbar.
notif_type_popupplus_desc:
Render notifications using a .popupskin file (Miranda NG / Popup Plus format).
Requires Pillow. Configure the skin folder in the Style tab.
lbl_dismiss_desc:
0 = never force-close. Also dismisses instantly
if you read the channel that sent the message.
chk_suppress_connect_desc:
Suppresses the balloon that appears when connecting
to Discord servers when Ballooncord starts.
icons_preview_hint: ► previews the icon in the tray immediately (reverts on next state change).
chk_status_icons_desc:
When enabled, the tray icon changes based on your Discord
status (online/dnd/idle/invisible). VC and unread states
still take priority over status icons.
status_icons_hint: PNG or ICO (16×16 recommended). Only used when the checkbox above is enabled.
